decisions.reason: As an agency-focused compliance tool close to the firm's existing hosting, support, and compliance know-how, it shows early positive user feedback and is likely to be retained while the firm learns and improves it through its own R&D.

This platform builds directly on the firm's core infrastructure, tooling, and technical service capabilities and its home-page prominence suggests it is strategically central, so absorptive capacity for improving it is very high.

A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the established business, easy for the firm to interpret and refine with existing knowledge and internal development, making withdrawal unlikely unless it is later merged into other plans.
